home_title: AI is coming home. Decide what it may do.
home_lead: mandate-spec is an open standard that lets every household say what an AI agent may do – allow, ask or deny.
home_construction: This website is still being built. Until then, the specification lives on GitHub.
home_allow_text: Done right away. Example: switch on the light.
home_ask_text: A person confirms first, on their phone. Example: open the front door.
home_deny_text: Refused. Example: switch off the alarm system.
home_rule: Whatever is not explicitly allowed is forbidden.
